text: Phase 1 foundations complete. 21 JVM and 23 Scala.js tests pass. Evidence covers primitive dtype capabilities, cast extrema/NaN/infinity/signed-zero parity, checked shape products, zero-sized canonical-stride overflow, reachable-address bounds, negative-stride logical-zero offsets, singleton broadcast flags, static CanDropAxis rejection for Rank[0], rank inference/refinement, owned construction, direct rank-1..4 indexing, dynamic indexing, and explicit traversal.
